name: Design Studio AI
use_label: Design workspace for people and agents
one_liner: Lets people and agents edit the same web, slide, 3D and video designs.

text.why: Ask an agent for a design and the result stays stuck in the chat, hard for a person to refine. Design Studio AI keeps web layouts, slides, reports, wireframes, 3D scenes and timeline videos in one versioned document that people and agents edit in turn, by chat or a manual editor. Agents connect over REST, MCP and a CLI, exports include HTML, PDF, PowerPoint and GLB, and generation uses outside providers with your own keys. Hosted studio or Docker self-host; MIT.
text.take: It aims at a document people also edit, not a chat output — that is the difference.
build: A proposal-deck flow where the agent drafts and a designer finishes
An internal workspace tying screen mock-ups to one design system
A small-studio pipeline keeping video and 3D scenes in the same document

who.situation: wants agent drafts they can finish by hand
needs an MCP or CLI path in and out of designs
keeping slide, screen and video mock-ups in one place

start.text: Hosted: start right away at studio.agentkit.best (nothing to install)
Self-host: set ENCRYPTION_KEY and APP_URL first (Node.js 24+ or Docker)
The container binds to 0.0.0.0:8787 · use an HTTPS proxy if internet-facing

caveat: Generation needs your own API keys and provider accounts
Google Slides export and similar were not live-verified, per the README
The CLI is not on npm; install from the release tarball

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
